name: Maxell Asia, Ltd
capabilities: Advanced SLIONTEC Tape Series for semiconductor manufacturing
Dicing Tape for wafers and packages
summary: Maxell Asia, Ltd is involved in the semiconductor value chain through its production of high-performance adhesive tapes under the SLIONTEC series. These tapes are designed for semiconductor wafer and package dicing, as well as back grinding protection, offering solutions that enhance precision, yield, and environmental safety in manufacturing processes.
